placements.title: Release integrity gating prevents unsigned artifacts from shipping
placements.frame: How is release integrity verified and enforced across deployment environments?
placements.why: The existing graph structure only contains Narrative_RollbackReadinessVerification, which focuses on operational rollback rehearsals rather than deployment gating or artifact provenance. The segments establish a mandatory release gate requiring signed manifests across staging and production to prevent unverified artifacts from reaching target environments.
